we have demonstrated a significant decrease in BDNF levels in the hippocampus, striatum, and cortex of the rat with hypothyroidism.
the brain is affected by hypothyroidism in a way similar to that of the peripheral organs, and that the effects of hypothyroidism are not restricted to the hypothalamus.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the brain is very sensitive to changes in thyroid function and thyroid hormone levels.
the thyroid hormones play an important role in brain health and development.
hypothyroidism is not only associated with cognitive decline but is also a risk factor for the development of neurodegenerative disease.
